app.name: Prohori
app.tagline: Check suspicious messages before you send money

landing.hero_subtitle: Paste suspicious SMS, Messenger, or WhatsApp messages to immediately know if it is a scam.
landing.card_message_desc: Check lottery wins, offers, account block notices, and suspicious texts.
landing.card_payment_desc: Check payment requests before sending money to anyone.
landing.card_sent_desc: What to do immediately if you have been scammed: hotlines and steps.
landing.promise_risk_desc: Scammers adapt constantly. Low risk still requires caution.
landing.promise_pii_desc: Phone numbers and PII in your message are masked immediately.
landing.promise_review_desc: Transparent analysis combining verified rules and intelligence.
landing.promise_helpline_desc: Direct tel links only for officially verified government and provider helplines.

result.low_subtitle: No known scam patterns matched, but stay alert for new tactics.

result.official_app_helpline_notice: Use the number in your provider's official app

result.mandatory_low_caution: Low risk does not mean 100% safe — always stay vigilant.
result.final_caution_line: Never share your PIN, OTP, or password with anyone.
result.not_found_desc: This check was not found or you do not have permission to view it.

share.share_desc: Share a masked, private link with someone you trust to get a second opinion before sending money.
share.privacy_guarantee: Zero personal data leaked: this link only shows masked text and risk indicators. No personal names, numbers, or account details are shared.
share.shared_by_relative: Someone you know shared this security check with you for your advice before taking action.
share.expired_title: This link has expired or is invalid
share.expired_desc: Shared check links automatically expire after 24 hours or when revoked by the sender to protect privacy. Please ask the sender to generate a new link if needed.

already_sent.title: Act now. Do this first.
already_sent.honest_line: Recovery is not guaranteed. Calling quickly gives the best chance.
already_sent.step1_desc: Select your provider below and call immediately. Ask them to freeze the fraudulent transaction and flag the recipient account.
already_sent.step2_desc: Do not delete any SMS, WhatsApp messages, or transaction records. Keep the TrxID and clear screenshots as official evidence.
already_sent.step3_desc: Anyone contacting you offering to 'recover' your lost money for an advance fee is running another scam. Legitimate authorities never charge recovery fees.
already_sent.step4_desc: Contact National Emergency Service 999 or CID Cyber Police hotline to report the fraud officially.
already_sent.offline_note: This emergency guide is saved and available without an internet connection.
